name: type-contract-safety-sweep
description: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-07-30, before any run. The remaining promotion gap: does arming type_contract HARM the fixtures it should never touch? The blast-radius scan says 6 of 7 built-in fixtures name no accepted type and so produce no contracts, but 'does not activate' is not the same as 'costs nothing'. PRIMARY METRIC: per-fixture pass rate, armed vs off, across all seven fixtures. A regression on any of the six non-triggering fixtures falsifies the safety claim outright. SECONDARY: turns on those six, which should be unchanged -- the gate still spawns one subprocess per done attempt even when it returns no findings, and that cost should be shown to be negligible rather than assumed. EXPECTED: identical outcomes on the six, and the adapter-migration effect already measured. FALSIFIED IF: any non-triggering fixture passes armed-off but fails armed, or typeContractRejections is non-zero on a fixture whose task names no accepted type.
